text: The TT-6200 has a rotating bayonet lid with a spring-loaded float valve. Its lockout pin rises as pressure builds and blocks the ring from turning. Operating pressure is about 10 psi.

Complaint history: the TT-6200 Q3-2024 lot has no field complaints about the lid. There were three complaints of "lid hard to open" on other lots in 2024. Complaints are tracked in the Ravenscar ticketing system.
Engineering change notice ECN-6200-14 added a retention clip to the lockout pin on later TT-6200 production.
The TT-5500 uses the same lockout pin as the TT-6200 but has a different locking ring and lid seat.
Client staffing and budget preferences: wants an estimate for each phase of a matter, staffing limited to one associate and one partner, and no more than two lawyers at any deposition or hearing.
Delphine Moorcroft in risk management coordinates with the insurer's claims adjuster on claims.

Client reporting requirement (Franklin Oyelaran, General Counsel, letter of March 9, 2026): case reports must be a single page. Each page should show the current exposure as a range in dollars, a few lines of status, upcoming dates, and any decision needed from the client. No narrative memos. Send a page monthly and after any event that changes the range, such as an inspection result or a ruling.

Authority limits: the firm has no settlement authority. Once it recommends a range, the client will take it to its claims group. No settlement offer may be made in any form without the General Counsel's written approval.

Client communication rules: send communications to Mr. Oyelaran with a copy to Delphine Moorcroft. Do not speak to the press or to retail partners, and refer inquiries to him. Do not contact client employees directly, as he arranges access. His technical contact is Rennick Odell, product safety lead. Quality records for the Q3-2024 production period are available on request, and complaints are tracked in the Ravenscar ticketing system. Tell him promptly of other claims involving the TT-6200 or related models.
The client has promised its largest retail partners advance warning before pulling any product from sale. It asked to be told at once if anything in the case could lead there.

Client instruction on plaintiff's counsel: be courteous, but do not volunteer information about customer complaint history or other incidents until a request is served and the scope has been discussed with the client. If a joint inspection is requested, agree in principle and send a written protocol.
